EMPOWERINGYOUNG PEOPLE

Creative Sparkworks, a Media & Arts, FILM & TV. skills & employment training charity, we work with disadvantaged youth. 

​

We are focused on empowering young people who are underrepresented and facing barriers to the world of employment in the creative industries. Our programs and projects respond to local needs and abilities to increase wellbeing, education, skills and employment opportunities.

COURSES

SPRINGBOARD COURSES

Intensive 5 days courses designed to enhance both your technical skills and introduce you to the industries. From Digital / Social Media Marketing to Video Editing, we aim to help you become a versatile and well-rounded creative professional.

BREAKTHROUGH 
ACADEMY

Sessions occur twice a week over 4 months. Hands on technical training including studio visits, industry led workshops and work shadowing. Focusing on camera operation, lighting, audio, screen-writing and editing.

IN MOTION

About Creative Sparkworks

A charity devoted to unlocking the creative potential of young people, especially those from underrepresented and disadvantaged backgrounds. We offer a platform where they can explore their creativity, develop valuable skills, and find their path in the creative industries. Through our tailored programs, we aim to break down barriers and foster an inclusive environment where every young person has the opportunity to thrive. We are dedicated to improving life chances.
